title: Change Readout
description: Stops changes being misread by showing them both ways (₹1,200 → ₹1,500 · +₹300 · +25%), keeping percentage points apart from percent (4% → 6% is +2 pts, +50%), refusing a % from a zero base or across zero, dividing by |base| for negatives, adding 2.5× when a value doubles, and marking whether the move is good or bad.
